content.scenario: Rahul, a consumer, files a complaint against a company with the District Commission. The mediator appointed, Mr. Kumar, has a personal connection with the company's CEO. Mr. Kumar must disclose this information to ensure a fair mediation process.
content.outcome: The mediator, Mr. Kumar, is required to disclose his personal connection with the company's CEO as it may give rise to a justifiable doubt about his independence or impartiality, as per Section 77 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
